title: 第7章 诡祟借命第8章 诡异的城防兵
slug: 无敌镖人开局护送灭世帝女
lines: “蠢货！”
陈观脸色一沉，来不及犹豫，他脚尖朝着挂在马鞍上的斩马刀轻轻一勾。
嗖！
那柄长近两米、宽约五寸的斩马刀脱壳而出，朝着天空射去。
紧接着，陈观双腿发力一跃而起，身体与那柄斩马刀平行，缓缓升空。
口中疾速念诵。
“天元归一，吾行八方，一语定乾坤！”
声音一落，他一指点在斩马刀刀面之上。
嗡！
斩马刀迸发出一道刺目紫光，瞬间照亮漆黑的野地，紫光不减形成一道神秘之力，将周围夜幕缓缓排开。
紧接着，陈观凌空一蹬，一个借力单脚踩在那斩马刀的刀柄之上，斩马刀停止飞升，带着他呼啸着向地面坠去！
轰！
碎石纷飞，斩马刀深深钉入地底，发出一声闷响后，留下一个刀柄在地面，闪烁着耀眼紫光。
陈观一直保持着没有回头。
做完这一切，他身形再次借力，轻飘飘落回马背。
陈观赶紧夹了马背，丢下洛璃，黑马迈开脚步继续朝着前方烛火跳动的方向走去。
“观来前之道，不犯过路之规，还望邪神……借那小丫头一命，如何？”
陈观开口喊了一句。
黑马依旧迈着沉稳的步伐，发出哒哒的声音，朝着与洛璃相反的方向继续前进。
陈观没有着急。
因为他们碰到了最为罕见、也最为棘手的——【诡祟】。
诡祟，无形无态、无逻辑、不可理喻。
它并非实体，而是一种规则与未知的纠缠体。
一旦无意中触发了它的“杀人规则”
，便会瞬间被拉入它的规则领域，身不由己。
而这一只，便是此地民间流传的怪谈诡——莫回头。
其规则简单粗暴：在这条路上听到任何异常声响，呼唤，绝不能回头。
一旦回头，便会被永远定格在回头的那一瞬间，直至生机消亡，形成一堆枯骨。
碰到这种规则诡异，唯有找出规则漏洞，打破规则才能脱身。
这是陈观有生以来碰到的第二只诡祟。
第一只，还是五年前，他遇到的一只——挑水婆婆。
也是一个像洛璃这样不知天高地厚的犟种书生，圣母心泛滥，在村口看一个老婆婆挑水吃力，便主动上去帮忙扶了一下扁担。
结果……那书生愣是替那“婆婆”
挑了三天三夜的水，直到活活累断了腰。
而他，也硬是在旁边坐了三天三夜，找到规则漏洞，才将那小子的魂从规则里给拽了回来。
黑色的骏马依旧迈着不紧不慢的脚步，陈焕依旧等着那东西的答复。
他不想去破什么规则，因为‘莫回头’，不像‘挑水婆婆’会给你时间帮她挑水。

"Idiot!"
Chen Guan's face darkened, and before he could hesitate, he lightly tipped his toes toward the sword hanging on the saddle.
Whoosh!
The sword, which was nearly two meters long and about five inches wide, came out of its shell and shot toward the sky.
Immediately afterwards, Chen Guan jumped up with his legs, his body parallel to the saber, and slowly rose into the air.
Chant quickly in your mouth.
"The heavenly essence is unified, I travel in all directions, and I can determine the world with one word!"
As soon as the voice fell, he pointed on the sword's surface.
Buzz!
The sword that killed the horse burst out with a dazzling purple light, instantly illuminating the dark wilderness. The purple light continued unabated, forming a mysterious force that slowly pushed away the surrounding night.
Immediately afterwards, Chen Guan kicked in the air and stepped on the handle of the sword with one foot. The sword stopped flying and fell to the ground with him whistling!
boom!
Rubbles flew everywhere, and the Zhanma sword was nailed deeply into the ground. After making a muffled sound, a hilt was left on the ground, shining with a dazzling purple light.
Chen Guan never looked back.
After doing all this, he used his strength again to fall back onto the horse.
Chen Guan quickly picked up the horse's back and left Luo Li behind. The black horse stepped forward and continued walking in the direction of the beating candlelight ahead.
"Observe the path ahead, don't violate the rules of the road, and hope the evil god... how about lending that little girl's life?"
Chen Guan shouted.
The black horse still walked at a steady pace, making a clicking sound, and continued to move in the opposite direction to Luo Li.
Chen Guan was not in a hurry.
Because they encountered the rarest and most difficult thing - [Cunning].
Creepy, formless, illogical, and unreasonable.
It is not an entity, but an entanglement of rules and unknowns.
Once its "killing rule" is accidentally triggered
, you will be instantly pulled into the realm of its rules, unable to control yourself.
And this one is the strange story spread among the people here - don't look back.
The rules are simple and rude: if you hear any unusual noises or calls on this road, you must never look back.
Once you look back, you will be frozen in the moment of turning back forever, until your life dies and becomes a pile of dead bones.
When encountering such weird rules, you can only escape by finding loopholes in the rules and breaking them.
This is the second ghost that Chen Guan has encountered in his life.
The first one was the one he met five years ago - Granny Water Bearer.
He was also a stubborn scholar like Luo Li who didn't know the heights of the world. He had a Holy Mother heart. He saw an old woman struggling to carry water at the entrance of the village, so he took the initiative to help with the pole.
As a result... the scholar was stunned for the "mother-in-law"
I carried water for three days and three nights until I broke my back from exhaustion.
And he just sat there for three days and three nights, found a loophole in the rules, and finally pulled the kid's soul back from the rules.
The black horse was still walking at a leisurely pace, and Chen Huan was still waiting for the thing's reply.
He doesn’t want to break any rules, because ‘don’t look back’, unlike the ‘Water Carrier Granny’ who will give you time to help her carry water.
